verdict.rationale: Evidence shows a public pricing page (sketch.com/pricing) listing enterprise-tier features like SSO, SCIM, permissions groups, and project archiving, plus a claim that AI features have 'no extra tiers, no add-ons' (implying flat inclusion). However, there's no evidence of an explicit seat-type breakdown or a clear tier-by-tier feature/AI-gating comparison table that a PM could use pre-procurement. Missing for 10: explicit seat-type definitions (e.g., Editor/Viewer/Guest pricing), a full tier comparison matrix, and confirmation of which AI features are gated per tier versus universally free.
